name: brandking
description: Instagram post, carousel, nine-grid and story director for Codex. Designs with ChatGPT image generation (ChatGPT Plus or higher), then measures its own pixels.

interface.shortDescription: Instagram posts, carousels and nine-grids, designed and measured.
interface.longDescription: A creative director for Instagram. Brandking writes the idea, the copy and the placement, designs with ChatGPT image generation, sets type with a local engine and measures the result. Image generation requires ChatGPT Plus or higher.
defaultPrompt: Build a six-slide carousel for this brand
Set up a nine-post grid for this product
Suggest post copy and placement for this photo
